name: my-PV AC•THOR / AC•THOR 9s
description:
Control your my-PV PV power manager via Modbus TCP
The example file shows the following:
Integration into the energy flow monitor (integrated power measurement of the AC THORS).
Charging excess PV power into the DHW storage via the heating rod.
Taking advantage of negative spot prices to heat the DHW storage from the grid via the heating rod.
Dropping the heating rod's load if, for example, the heating rod is charging the hot water from the grid and the connection is "overloaded."
Preparation for mutual interlocking (the rod does not heat if, for example, the heat pump is producing hot water, and vice versa).
To control the ACTHOR / 9s via Loxone, you need to set "Modbus TCP" as the "Control Type" in the ACTHOR control settings.
The "Control Timeout" must be set to 60 seconds.
How to download the web setup and configure a static IP address is described in the operating manual. The latest operating manual can always be accessed in the download center.
https://www.my-pv.com/de/info/downl

name: Rituals Perfume Genie
description:
With this templates you are able to control a Rituals Genie sent
This template contains the string "REPLACE_WITH_HUB_HASH"
This is the ID of your personal parfume genie.
In order to get this, please do the following steps:
curl -d "email=<your-email>&password=<your-password>" https://rituals.sense-company.com/ocapi/login
This will return a json including an "account_hash" field.
Copy this field and paste it in the fowllowing request:
curl https://rituals.sense-company.com/api/account/hubs/<account_hash> | jq
This will list all the perfume genie devices attached to your rituals account.
A parfume genie is called a "hub"
Now copy the "hash" from the correct hub.
Open the loxone config and change "REPLACE_WITH_HUB_HASH" with the copied value.
Once you have the hash it will never change and this hash is unauthenticated, therefore loxone will always be able to call the endpoints.

name: Captive Video Server
description:

The recordings are stored in MP4 format on the recording server or local network drive so you can easily view them in any browsers or on any device.
This works with or without existing Network of Digital Video Recorders (NVRs / DVRs), by essentially piggy backing on the cameras RTSP feed.
With Loxone as the trigger point it provides a lot of off grid video control. Want a video of somebody who's opened your gun safe? No problem. cold water sensors (temperature, cold water used...)

The Denon HEOS is a network connected, wireless, multi-room music system. The HEOS Command Line Interface (CLI) allows external control systems to manage, browse, play, and get status from the Denon HEOS products. The HEOS CLI is accessed through a telnet connection between the HEOS product and the control system. The control system sends commands and receives responses over the network connection. The commands and responses for browsing music servers and services use a RESTFUL like approach while other commands and responses are more static.

name: PCE EV11.3
description:
Template for the PCE EV11.3 Wallbox
This document serves as a template for integrating the PCE EV11.3 Wallbox using the Modbus TCP protocol. The Wallbox is equipped with advanced functionality, including automatic phase switching between single-phase (1P) and three-phase (3P) charging modes. This allows the charging system to dynamically adapt to the available power supply, optimizing energy usage and improving efficiency.
To enable the automatic phase switching feature, it is essential to activate the designated DIP switch located on the internal circuit board of the Wallbox. Failure to activate this switch will prevent the device from performing automatic switching, and it will operate in a fixed phase mode.
For detailed information on register mapping and configuration settings, please refer to the official PCE EV11.3 documentation.
